provenance.method: Independent source frame30 manual rail/strip review and local contrast-centroid measurement of O/Y; fixed seven-landmark template reconstruction.

manual_observations.TR: Approximate intersection of adjoining top/right rail lines around the corner pocket in this raw frame.
manual_observations.BR: Approximate intersection of adjoining bottom/right rail lines around the corner pocket in this raw frame.
manual_observations.B: Visible narrow dark strip attached to the upper cushion; manually located near its cloth-side centre, not the old out-of-image location.

provenance.O_Y_measurement: 19x19 grayscale windows; nonnegative (local median - pixel - 8) contrast weights; no red-ball coordinates used.
provenance.limitation: TR/BR are image rail-intersection estimates around pockets, and B is a few-pixel mark attached to a dark rail. O/Y centroids are repeatable measurements, not surveyed true positions. All inferred corners and template residuals retain image/template uncertainty.
